## Farrand Hall at the University of Colorado Boulder

This is likely the most well-known Farrand Hall. It's a residence hall on the CU Boulder campus, part of the Farrand Field residential area. It's named after **Livingston Farrand**, who served as president of the University of Colorado from 1914 to 1919.

## Farrand Hall at Cornell University

There's also a building associated with Cornell, connected to Livingston Farrand who later became Cornell's president (1921-1937).

There may be Farrand Halls at other institutions, as the name appears in various educational contexts.
